situations.title: 동맥압 라인 파형·영점 사정
situations.tagline: Nurse, that wavy line on the monitor keeps looking different — is something wrong with my blood pressure?
situations.brief: 트랜스듀서 위치와 영점을 확인하고 동맥압 파형의 이상 여부를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to re-level and zero the line so we get an accurate reading.
The transducer needs to sit at the level of your heart.
The waveform looks a little off, so let me check the setup.
goals: 정상 파형과 이상 파형을 구분해 보고한다

situations.title: NIBP와 동맥압 값 불일치 확인
situations.tagline: The cuff on my arm said one number but the screen shows another — which one is right?
situations.brief: 커프 혈압과 동맥압 라인 값을 비교하고 차이를 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me compare the cuff reading with the arterial line.
A small difference between the two can be normal.
I'll let the team know which reading we're trusting right now.
goals: 커프와 라인 값의 차이를 확인하고 원인을 판단한다

situations.title: 승압제 주입 라인·펌프 확인
situations.tagline: Can you double-check the norepi line with me before I take over the pump?
situations.brief: 승압제 전용 중심라인과 농도, 라벨을 점검하고 펌프 설정을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the norepinephrine is running through the dedicated central line.
I'll verify the concentration and the pump settings.
The label matches the order and the bag.
goals: 전용 중심라인과 농도, 라벨을 정확히 점검한다

situations.title: MAP 목표 환자·가족 설명
situations.tagline: The doctor keeps mentioning a target for his 'average pressure' — what does that actually mean for him?
situations.brief: 목표 MAP의 의미를 가족이 이해하기 쉬운 말로 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The average pressure tells us if his organs are getting enough blood.
We're aiming to keep that number in a safe range.
The medication helps us hold that target steady.
goals: 목표 수치를 관리하는 이유를 가족에게 이해시킨다

situations.title: 시간당 활력징후 경향 기록
situations.tagline: How have her numbers been trending over the last few hours?
situations.brief: 시간당 활력징후 추세를 인지하고 정확히 문서화하세요.
keyPhrases: Her blood pressure has been slowly trending down over the last three hours.
I'm charting the vitals every hour to catch any change early.
The trend matters more than any single reading.

situations.title: 중심정맥압 측정 준비
situations.tagline: You're laying my bed flat again — is this for another measurement?
situations.brief: 자세와 영점, 측정 시점을 정렬해 중심정맥압 측정을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll position you flat so the reading is accurate.
I need to zero the line at the right level first.
We measure at end-expiration to get the true value.

situations.title: 노르에피네프린 적정
situations.tagline: Her pressure keeps dropping — is that medication going to be enough?
situations.brief: MAP 목표를 유지하도록 노르에피네프린 용량을 조정하고 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: We're adjusting the medication to keep her blood pressure in a safe range.
I'll update the team on how she's responding.
Her average pressure is our main target right now.
goals: MAP 목표에 맞춰 용량을 단계적으로 조정한다
반응과 관류 지표를 팀에 정확히 보고한다

situations.title: 바소프레신 병용 도입
situations.tagline: They're adding a second drip now — is she getting worse?
situations.brief: 이차 승압제 바소프레신 시작 시점을 판단하고 감시 항목을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: We're adding a second medication to support her pressure.
This works alongside the first drip, not instead of it.
I'll watch closely for how she responds.
goals: 병용 시 감시 지표를 확인하고 소통한다

situations.title: 소변량·젖산 관류지표 통합 해석
situations.tagline: What's her urine output and lactate been doing since we started the pressors?
situations.brief: 소변량과 젖산 등 관류지표를 통합해 관류 개선 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Her urine output has picked up to about 40 mls an hour.
The lactate is trending down, which is reassuring.
Together these suggest her perfusion is improving.

situations.title: 동맥압 파형 감쇠 감별
situations.tagline: This trace looks damped to me — can you take a look before we trust the number?
situations.brief: under/over-damped 파형 문제를 감별하고 원인을 해결하세요.
keyPhrases: The waveform looks overdamped, so the reading may be falsely low.
Let me do a fast-flush test to check the system.
I'll look for air bubbles, kinks, or a loose connection.

situations.title: 승압제 감량·이탈 시도
situations.tagline: So the drip is finally coming down — does that mean she's turning the corner?
situations.brief: weaning 기준에 따라 승압제를 감량하고 저혈압 재발을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We're slowly lowering the medication as her pressure holds.
I'll watch closely in case her blood pressure drops again.
We reduce it in small steps, not all at once.

situations.title: 도부타민 강심제 추가
situations.tagline: They mentioned his heart isn't pumping strongly enough — what's this new medicine for?
situations.brief: 저심박출을 판단해 도부타민을 추가하고 부정맥 발생을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: This medication helps his heart pump more effectively.
It can speed up the heart rate, so we watch the rhythm closely.
We'll see if his circulation improves over the next hour.

situations.title: 저용량 승압제 말초 일시 투여 판단
situations.tagline: Central access isn't in yet — are we okay to run low-dose pressors through this peripheral line for now?
situations.brief: 말초 승압제 투여 프로토콜의 한계를 인지하고 일시 투여 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: We can run low-dose pressors peripherally only for a short time.
It has to be a good, proximal IV, and we watch the site closely.
We still need central access placed as soon as possible.
goals: 일시 투여 여부와 감시 계획을 판단한다

situations.title: 수액 반응성 평가
situations.tagline: Do you want to do a passive leg raise before we give another bolus?
situations.brief: passive leg raise와 맥압변이를 해석해 수액 반응성을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's do a passive leg raise and watch the pressure response.
If the pulse pressure variation drops, she's likely fluid responsive.
This helps us decide if another bolus will actually help.

situations.title: 승압제 무중단 이중펌프 전환
situations.tagline: The bag's almost empty — let's do a double-pump swap so the titration doesn't drop.
situations.brief: titration이 끊기지 않도록 이중펌프로 승압제 라인을 교체하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll start the new pump before stopping the old one.
We overlap them so there's no gap in the drip.
Watch the pressure while we make the switch.

situations.title: 불응성 쇼크 다중 승압
situations.tagline: Give me the picture — what's she on and where's her pressure sitting?
situations.brief: 고용량 병용 승압을 관리하고 원인을 재평가하며 SBAR로 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: She's on max norepinephrine plus vasopressin and her MAP is still low.
We should reassess for a reversible cause.
I'm escalating this now using SBAR.

situations.title: 노르에피 말초 침윤 조직괴사 위험
situations.tagline: Her hand is going pale and cold around the IV — I think the norepi is infiltrating.
situations.brief: 승압제 침윤을 인지하고 phentolamine 등 처치와 에스컬레이션을 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the infusion — this looks like an infiltration.
We need phentolamine to treat the extravasation.
I'm calling the physician and elevating the arm.

situations.title: 승압제 급성 중단 혈압 붕괴
situations.tagline: The line got pulled and her pressure just crashed — we need access back now!
situations.brief: 라인 이탈로 인한 혈압 붕괴 위기에 대응하고 승압 경로를 신속히 재확보하세요.
keyPhrases: The pressor line is out and her pressure is bottoming out.
Get me another line — we need to restart the drip immediately.
Push fluids while I regain access.

situations.title: 승압 중 급성 서맥 심정지 전조
situations.tagline: Her heart rate is dropping into the 30s — this looks like a pre-arrest, call it!
situations.brief: 급성 서맥과 심정지 전조를 인지해 즉각 보고하고 소생을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Her heart rate is crashing into the 30s.
Call the code team and get the crash cart.
Start atropine and prepare for CPR.

situations.title: 승압 불응 하이드로코르티손 추가
situations.tagline: Now they're adding a steroid too — is that a sign things are getting desperate?
situations.brief: 부신 보조를 위한 하이드로코르티손 추가의 근거를 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The steroid helps her body respond to the blood pressure medications.
We add it when the pressure stays low despite the drips.
It's a standard step in this kind of shock, not a last resort.

situations.title: 임계 저관류 기계보조 고려
situations.tagline: Her perfusion is critical despite everything — we should call the ECMO team.
situations.brief: 임계 저관류 상황에서 ECMO 등 상급치료로의 에스컬레이션을 준비하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: She's critically underperfused despite maximal support.
We should activate the ECMO team now.
I'll get everything ready and update the family.
